deliverable: Create Founding Architect Welcome and Retention Plan
description: Define communications and touchpoints from purchase through Blueprint completion and toward Community opening so Founding Architects maintain continuity after purchase. Coordinate email, Founder, Lumina, and Community messaging.
assignedTitle: Michelle Northstar — Chief of Staff & Operations Officer
michelleScope: operations, orchestration, Launch Readiness coordination of welcome/retention touchpoints. Does not take Imani security/infra ownership or Nia curriculum/brand ownership.
acceptanceAuthority: Kimberly Walker (human) only. This file does not record Founder acceptance. Customer-facing copy in this plan is proposed intent only until Founder accepts Nia-authored language.
syntheticLabel: Not a live participant send. No emails were sent. No Stripe charges. No Community experience was opened.
purpose: Keep Founding Architects in a continuous relationship after purchase: they know what they bought, how to begin, how to continue the Journey, what happens when the Blueprint is complete, and what is true about Architect Community before it opens. Continuity is the job. Pressure is not.

lockedFacts.foundingArchitectInclusions: Blueprint + first six months of Architect Community. Not first year.
lockedFacts.renewalAfterIncludedPeriod: $50/month after the first six months of Architect Community access
lockedFacts.refunds: No refunds. Cancellation is not a refund.
lockedFacts.positioning: From expectation to intention. Magical is Possible.
lockedFacts.journeyPacingRule: There is no race through this Journey. Move thoughtfully. Do not send urgency-to-complete copy.
sources: content/legal/v1-candidates.ts Membership Agreement §7 Founding Architect Bundle

inScope: Touchpoint map from Founding Architect purchase through Blueprint / Journey completion and toward Architect Community opening
Channel coordination across email, in-product Founder media, Lumina, dashboard, support, and pre-opening Community messaging
Cadence, owners, triggers, and fallbacks so continuity does not depend on a single channel
Handoffs to Nia (copy / Community Runway / Lumina voice) and Imani (transactional email / lifecycle automation)
Coordination findings that would break continuity if left unaligned
outOfScope: Product, marketing, legal, Journey, Lumina, or checkout file changes
Stripe, Cloudflare DNS, Vercel custom-domain, or nameserver changes
Inventing a new Community program, first-year benefit, or live Community experience before October 25, 2026
Writing final Founder-facing or participant-facing copy (Nia brand/curriculum ownership)
Implementing Resend/Kit/SMTP lifecycle automations (Imani Row 146 / Row 147)
Marking Command Center row Complete or recording Founder acceptance
Treating Kimberly Walker (AI) as execution capacity

continuityArc.audience: Purchasers of checkout offerId bundle (Founding Architect). Blueprint-only and standalone Community purchasers are adjacent; they are not the primary audience of this plan.
continuityArc.objective: After money is taken, the Architect always has a next true step and a true statement about Community. Silence after purchase is the failure mode.

phases.name: Purchase and access
phases.window: At checkout success through first authenticated session
phases.continuityJob: Confirm what was bought, grant access, get them into onboarding. State Community timing without implying it is live.

phases.name: Welcome and begin
phases.window: Onboarding steps welcome → preferences → consent → lumina → assessment → awakening
phases.continuityJob: Founder welcome (video + letter) and Lumina introduction happen in-product. Email does not replace them.

phases.name: Seven-chapter Journey
phases.window: Chapter I The Awakening through Chapter VII The Beginning
phases.continuityJob: Chapter Founder media + Lumina journey-aware replies + dashboard continue-Journey. Email is a resume prompt, not a curriculum substitute.

phases.name: Blueprint / Journey completion
phases.window: Chapter VII complete, completion experience, certificate
phases.continuityJob: Honor completion. Do not dump them into a missing Community. Point to the locked October 25 opening if it has not occurred.

phases.name: Blueprint complete → Community opening
phases.window: From journey_completed until October 25, 2026 00:00 America/New_York (or until Community is actually open)
phases.continuityJob: This is the highest-risk continuity gap. Keep a Founder/Lumina/email presence that is honest: Community is coming, not live. Do not invent programming.

phases.name: Toward Community opening
phases.window: Approximately 14 days before October 25, 2026 through opening day
phases.continuityJob: Coordinate opening communications with Nia Row 159 runway. Founding Architect included period is first six months commencing October 25, 2026.

phases.name: Included Community period (retention after opening)
phases.continuityJob: Welcome into the live Community when it exists. Preview $50/month renewal without surprise. Out of August 31 launch-day scope to operate; in scope to name so purchase-time promises match later mail.

email.role: Confirm, remind, resume, and announce — never replace Founder or Lumina.
email.separationRule: Transactional (purchase, access, billing, support ack) stays SMTP/Resend path under Imani. Non-transactional lifecycle (progress, inspiration, Community preview) requires sender identity, footer, unsubscribe, and suppression (Row 162). Do not mix Kit marketing blasts with payment mail.

founder.role: Belonging and pacing. The human Founder voice at the moments that change identity.
inProductNow: Chapter I–VII Founder welcome videos and captions
founder.notABlastChannel: Do not schedule ad-hoc Founder inbox mail from kimberly@thebackhalf.org as a retention drip. Founder email, if used, is a named approved asset (see Row 199 launch email pattern: approved, not sent, not loaded into platform without Founder action).

lumina.role: Companion inside the Journey. Continuity between sessions. Does not announce Community as live. Does not impersonate Kimberly.
inProductNow: Authenticated Lumina conversation with journey-aware context (lib/lumina/conversation.ts)
Chapter VII completion orientation: Your Journey does not end here—it begins here.
lumina.coordinationRule: Lumina may acknowledge Journey state and invite the next saved step. Community questions must use locked copy: Architect Community — Coming October 25, 2026; Founding Architect includes the first six months; not live on August 31. Nia owns Lumina wording; Michelle flags contradictions; Imani does not change brand voice.

community.role: Until October 25, 2026 this is messaging only — not a live experience.
community.allowedNow: Timing, inclusion, first-six-months period, renewal at $50/month, and what happens after Blueprint completion — using locked facts.
forbiddenNow: Live Community invitation, feed, events, or 'welcome in' language that implies the space is open
October 19 or any date other than October 25, 2026

dashboardAndJourney.role: Default next-step surface. Email and Lumina should return here.

support.publicIdentity: The Back Half Support. Never Kimberly.
support.communityAnswer: Architect Community is not live August 31. Architect Community — Coming October 25, 2026. Founding Architect includes the first six months of Architect Community access.

touchpoints.name: Checkout success surface

touchpoints.intent: Thank you. Offer named. Next step: Begin Journey onboarding or Architect Dashboard. Do not claim Community is open.

touchpoints.name: Account verification email
touchpoints.intent: Get them into the account. Not a welcome essay.

touchpoints.name: Payment failed email
touchpoints.intent: No paid access granted. Invite retry. No Community language.

touchpoints.name: Founder Welcome video and letter
touchpoints.intent: Primary welcome. Honors the purchase as an investment in self. Sets pacing: no race. Magical is Possible. Does not open Community.

touchpoints.name: Preferences, consent, Lumina intro, Aliveness, Awakening entry
touchpoints.intent: Complete the start. Lumina is introduced as AI Guide inside the Journey, not as Community host.

touchpoints.name: Onboarding incomplete resume email
touchpoints.trigger: onboarding_started and not onboarding_completed after 24 hours; second send at 7 days if still open
touchpoints.intent: Your Founder Welcome is waiting. Continue onboarding. No urgency, no discount, no Community-is-live.
touchpoints.owner: nia copy; imani Row 147 trigger; michelle cadence

touchpoints.name: Dashboard welcome
touchpoints.trigger: Authenticated Architect Dashboard after onboarding or mid-flow
touchpoints.intent: Welcome, {name}. Continue onboarding or Continue Journey. Support link present.

touchpoints.name: Chapter Founder welcome videos I–VII
touchpoints.intent: Each chapter opens with Founder media. Continuity inside the Journey is Founder + Lumina, not email volume.

touchpoints.name: Lumina journey-aware replies
touchpoints.intent: Meet the Architect at the saved chapter. Do not rewrite their work. Do not invent Community programming.

touchpoints.name: Gentle resume email after inactivity
touchpoints.trigger: No journey_progress_saved or journey_resumed for 14 days while Journey in_progress and onboarding_completed. Cap at 3 sends before Community opening. Suppress if they asked for pause or unsubscribed from non-transactional mail.
touchpoints.intent: Your Journey is still here. There is no race. Continue when you are ready. CTA = Continue Journey. Community line only if asked in FAQ footer using locked coming-October-25 copy.
touchpoints.owner: nia copy; imani Row 147; michelle cadence
touchpoints.pacingConstraint: Must honor Journey 'no race' language. Do not use streaks, loss-aversion, or countdown-to-complete.

touchpoints.name: Mid-Journey Lumina check-in (in-product only)
touchpoints.trigger: Architect opens Lumina after a gap (journey_resumed already emitted after >6 hours)
touchpoints.existing: partial — journey context exists; no push notification
touchpoints.intent: When they return, Lumina orients to current chapter. No outbound Lumina email.

touchpoints.name: Journey Completion Founder video + certificate
touchpoints.intent: Honor completion. Your Journey does not end here—it begins here. Do not auto-enroll into a live Community UI.

touchpoints.name: Blueprint completion email
touchpoints.intent: Congratulate. Point to certificate/resources. If before October 25, 2026: Architect Community — Coming October 25, 2026. Founding Architect includes the first six months (October 25, 2026 through April 25, 2027). If on/after October 25: defer to Nia Row 159 live-opening copy; do not invent it here.
touchpoints.owner: nia copy; imani trigger; michelle coordination with Row 159

touchpoints.name: Post-completion continuity note
touchpoints.intent: You finished. Community is not open yet. You remain an Architect. Lumina and resources remain. We will write before October 25. No fake events calendar.
touchpoints.cadence: One note within 48 hours of completion if Community is still unopened; one reminder ~14 days before October 25 if not already in T16 window. No weekly drip of invented Community content.
touchpoints.owner: nia Row 159 copy; michelle cadence; imani send
touchpoints.blockedBy: Row 159 Community Runway is Not Started

touchpoints.owner: nia Row 159 primary; michelle orchestration; imani delivery

messageCoordinationRules.founderVsLumina: Founder media carries belonging and chapter openings. Lumina carries between-session companionship and saved-work orientation. Lumina does not send as Kimberly and does not replace Founder Welcome.
messageCoordinationRules.emailVsInProduct: If SMTP/lifecycle is not ready, in-product Founder + Lumina + dashboard still deliver P0–P3. Email is required for P4–P5 because completers who leave the product otherwise go silent before October 25.
messageCoordinationRules.bilingual: Account locale en/es. Do not send English Founder or Lumina lines in Español mode. Row 145 templates remain a blocker for ES lifecycle mail.
messageCoordinationRules.lateEnrollment: Enrollment may run through December 31, 2026. What remaining Community period a December purchaser receives is a Row 159 / legal consistency question. This plan does not invent a new remaining-period formula. Until Row 159 and legal agree, public copy stays: period October 25, 2026 through April 25, 2027.
